title: Nekocraft
description: Nekocraft Season 2 is a whitelisted community server featuring an industrial, sky-bound sandbox powered by the Create Mod and Create Aeronautics. Build automated factories, pilot custom airships, and explore a deeply immersive world.
body:
Nekocraft Season 2 is a whitelisted community server featuring an industrial, sky-bound sandbox powered by the Create Mod and Create Aeronautics. Build automated factories, pilot custom airships, and explore a deeply immersive world.

Join the [discord](https://discord.com/invite/7pGAsJjKPz) server to apply!
